parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans expression or same-sex conduct, no documented border/document friction, and no universal facility ban for visitors. But the dossier documents real exposure: a trans detainee held in a male guarded centre with HRT cut for three months (remedy only after NGO intervention); hate-crime/hate-speech coverage of gender identity struck down and never entering force; widespread documented social hostility (LGBT-free zone legacy, official threat-framing rhetoric, violent counter-protest), leaving thin recourse for identity-based insults or service refusal. Weighed against this, courts have worked for trans people: Convention damages for medication denial (2024), non-binary discrimination ruling (2025), annulment of anti-LGBT resolutions. Violence evidence is stale (2019 survey) and event-scoped; no organised targeting or state campaign. Worst features are societal hostility with partial recourse and one custody-medication incident — Elevated/upper-end, roughly 0.56.
